descriptionChirho: Qal: to be in a low state, be brought low, be humbled — describing the passive or stative condition of being abased or diminished.
Hifil causative: to actively bring low, humble, abase, or cast down another person, nation, or thing.
Hifil intransitive/reflexive: to voluntarily lower oneself, humble oneself, or condescend to stoop down — used of deliberate self-abasement or divine condescension.
